meta.name: launching-agent-teams
meta.description: Launches agent teams with structured roles and task decomposition. Use when asked to create a team, spawn teammates, or coordinate multiple agents in parallel.

copy.tagline: 启动多智能体团队协作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要协调多个AI代理并行处理复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Launch multi-agent teams with structured roles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents for complex tasks.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会能启动一个由 3-5 名 AI 队友组成的团队，每个队友有独立分工，并行执行任务。Claude 先分解任务、定义角色，展示团队结构让用户批准，再启动团队。用户可在运行中与队友直接交流或审批计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建 AI 团队、召唤队友或协调多个 agent 并行时触发。用户需先启用实验性 agent teams 设置。

say.text: 帮我创建一个前后端AI团队来开发这个项目。
say.note: Claude会分解任务并展示团队结构供批准。

say.text: 启动一个3人团队，分别负责设计、编码和测试。
say.note: Claude将按角色并行启动队友。

say.text: 协调两个agent并行分析不同数据集。
say.note: Claude会创建并行工作的队友。

howto.what_en: Claude can launch a team of 3-5 AI teammates, each with a distinct role, working in parallel. It decomposes tasks, defines roles, presents the team structure for approval, then starts the team. Users can message teammates directly or approve plans during execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to create an AI team, spawn teammates, or coordinate multiple agents in parallel. User must enable the experimental agent teams setting first.

say_en.text: Create a frontend and backend AI team for this project.
say_en.note: Claude decomposes and presents structure for approval.

say_en.text: Launch a 3-person team for design, coding, and testing.
say_en.note: Claude spawns teammates with distinct roles.

say_en.text: Coordinate two agents to analyze different data sets in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude creates teammates for parallel work.
